title: CML-07 semantic closure Definition drift audit

findings.condition: Validation execution, schema or identity-contract conformance, implementation conformance, and runtime conformance were previously not distinguished.
findings.remediation: Use the exact Definition references and scoped conformance kinds in successor chain 0002.

findings.condition: Artifact Type, Evidence, Evaluation, Validation, Conformance, Validation Receipt, Identity Carrier, and Identity Lineage had no canonical Lab Definition candidates.
findings.remediation: Review and bind these eight candidates with candidate 0006 at the final CML-07 decision boundary.

findings.condition: Artifact Type/v1 accepted semantic_kind labels without a semantic Definition reference.
findings.remediation: Use Artifact Type/v2 for new registrations; preserve v1 registrations through an exact predecessor reference.

findings.condition: Candidate 0006 resolved collapse only for Product, Project, Method, Craft Method, Goal, and Identity Relation, not the complete CML-07 vocabulary.
findings.remediation: Keep candidate 0006 immutable and interpret its closure claim only within its named six-term scope.

findings.condition: All semantic records and Artifact Type/v2 remain candidate-unadmitted.
findings.remediation: Include exact candidate, source, owner, registry-postimage, Artifact Type/v2, and validation digests in the configured final decision request set before S2.

findings.condition: The three selected source ranges are current but are not admitted for the Lab semantic-closure use.
findings.remediation: Author exact source-admission candidate clauses and bind them at the final CML-07 decision boundary; do not infer admission from currentness.

claim_ceiling: This audit describes candidate semantic closure and remaining admission dependencies only. It does not change live definitions, establish conformance, admit Artifact Type/v2, or authorize CML-07 S2.
